Requirement At least three broken or destroyed firearms, or an equivalent volume of scrap.

Check Crafting against a DC set by the GM

Assemble one functioning scrap gun of any type you have handled before. On a success the weapon is usable and carries a Failure Range; on a critical success it also does not Gun Failure for the first hour it is fired. The donor weapons are consumed, and this cannot produce or repair a Good Gun.
